approval.program_implementation_scope: all indexed requirements after dependencies and machine gates are satisfied

delivery_mode_policy.evaluation_point: before a requirement advances beyond specified
delivery_mode_policy.decision_rule: Evaluate a candidate in this order, treating every missing or ambiguous predicate as false: (1) use sibling_requirements when the candidate contains two or more end-to-end outcomes, each has its own acceptance and rollback, and the approved target permits at least one outcome to reach and remain fixed_dev while another is permanently absent, blocked, or superseded; (2) otherwise use staged_epic only when the candidate has exactly one parent outcome and one final exit, has two or more named mandatory milestones in a finite acyclic graph, no milestone may be permanently omitted, every milestone is separately branchable, mergeable, acceptance-testable, and revertible, every proper intermediate state is supported without a compatibility shim, and recorded dependency, evidence, or rollback facts prove that one-branch delivery is unsafe; (3) otherwise use leaf.

sibling_requirements.index_representation: each outcome is an indexed requirement; any legacy parent is a non-executable superseded navigation record

staged_epic.index_representation: one indexed parent with a finite acyclic milestones list; the parent reaches fixed_dev only after every milestone reaches fixed_dev

leaf.index_representation: one indexed requirement and one end-to-end delivery unit

does_not_authorize: using milestones for optional outcomes that meet the sibling_requirements predicates
using milestones only to separate characterization, tests, core, surface, documentation, staffing, or calendar phases without a supported intermediate state
combining multiple milestones in one issue, branch, commit, acceptance, or rollback unit
advancing requirement or milestone status beyond specified
starting implementation before ready gates are satisfied
main integration, release, production probes, external writes, or safety exceptions
delivery_mode_policy.implementation_authorization_effect: Selecting a compliant delivery mode is authorized for indexed requirements, but implementation still requires the existing dependency, review, ready, worktree, write-scope, and machine-gate bindings.
